title: Kickin Quick Malaysian Padron Peppers Skewers
description: A pungent and springy Malaysian dish featuring Padron peppers, this quick-fix recipe is perfect for a snack or appetizer. It is also diabetic-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Thread 2-3 Padron peppers onto each skewer.
Sprinkle both sides of the peppers with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, paprika, and chili flakes.
Dip each skewer into the hot oil and fry for 2-3 minutes on each side, until the peppers are tender and slightly charred.
Remove the skewers from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Drizzle the skewers with lemon juice and serve immediately.
Repeat the frying process with the remaining skewers.
Serve the skewers hot and enjoy.
